body.name: cardinality-uniform observable-data minimax risk
body.construction: \(R_T(t_0,\zeta,C):=\inf_{\widehat\theta\in\sigma(\mathsf O_T,\mathcal X,\mathcal A,b,e,t_0,\zeta,C,M_1,M_2)}\sup_{M\in\mathcal M_T(t_0,\zeta,C)}E_M[(\widehat\theta-\theta(K,e))^2]\), where the infimum is over all measurable estimators; \(\mathcal X,\mathcal A,b,e,t_0,\zeta,C,M_1,M_2\) are supplied, whereas \(\mathcal H,K,d_b,d_e\) are not.
